outcomeNote: mishna ruling; 90b.6 is the chapter colophon

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמַּצְנִיעַ לְזֶרַע וּלְדוּגְמָא וְלִרְפוּאָה וְהוֹצִיאוֹ בְּשַׁבָּת — חַיָּיב בְּכׇל שֶׁהוּא. וְכׇל אָדָם — אֵין חַיָּיב עָלָיו אֶלָּא כְּשִׁיעוּרוֹ. חָזַר וְהִכְנִיסוֹ — אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב אֶלָּא כְּשִׁיעוּרוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who stores» a seed «for sowing, or as a sample, or for medicinal purposes and carried it out on Shabbat is liable» for carrying out «any amount.» By storing that measure, he indicates that it is significant to him. Therefore, he is liable for carrying it, despite the fact that what he carried out is less than the halakhic measure that determines liability for that item. «And any» other «person is only liable» for carrying it out on Shabbat «if» he carries out «its measure» for liability. If one stored the seed, carried it out, «and then brought it back in,» with no intention to utilize it for the specific purpose for which he stored it, «he is only liable if» he brought in «its measure» for liability (Rav Shmuel Strashun).

moves.summary: the storer is liable for any amount

moves.cueHe: וכל אדם אין חייב עליו אלא כשיעורו
moves.summary: anyone else only for the standard measure
if he brought it back in, only for the standard measure

positions.claim: one who stored an item for a purpose is liable for any amount; others and one who brought it back in only for the standard measure
